identity.name: ABC News Australia
identity.description: The news service of Australia's public broadcaster, covering national, regional and international affairs across radio, television and digital.

ownership.ownershipNotes: A statutory public broadcaster funded by the Australian government. Its charter requires independence and balance; funding and board appointments are politically contested.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Statutory charter and editorial independence requirements; coverage includes criticism of Australian governments.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Broad public-service framing, generally centrist with strong climate and social coverage; no clean MBFC rating parsed.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is explanatory and policy-oriented, without a consistent market or state-directed programme.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames regional affairs through Australian alliance and Pacific-island perspectives.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established public broadcaster with editorial standards and corrections; no MBFC rating parsed in this review.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: MBFC page was not found at the sampled URL; no rating identified. Assessed from charter and feed metadata.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Australian public-broadcaster voice. Strong on Pacific islands, climate and rural Australia, with a regional rather than global-breaking-news focus.

selectionRationale: Adds essential Pacific and Australian public-service coverage that UK/US outlets underreport.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Public-service ownership differs from state-controlled media; mapping is a compatibility compromise. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
